# Luminous bobbleheads / bobblehead guide including map

![Glowing bobbleheads / bobblehead guide including map](/uploads/480_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In addition to the well-known bobbleheads, there are now also **luminous bobbleheads**. These are even **rare** than the regular bobbleheads found in Appalachia. The spawn points are the same. However, they have no further advantage.

## All bobblehead effects

The effect of the glowing bobbleheads is the same as the normal ones.

- **Leader Bobblehead**
"Lead by example."
 You gain +5% more experience for 1 hour when used.
- **Endurance Bobblehead**
"You always have to be ready to give everything for the team."
 You gain +2 Stamina for 1 hour when used.
- **Agility Bobblehead**
"Don't be afraid to avoid tricky problems."
 You gain +2 Agility for 1 hour when used.
- **Energy Weapon Bobblehead**
"Peaceful solutions are achieved through superior firepower."
 When used, deal +20% more damage with energy weapons for 1 hour.
- **Lucky bobblehead**
"There is only one way to give 110%."
 You gain +2 luck for 1 hour when used.
- **Big Gun Bobblehead**
"The best way to win an argument is to use volume."
 When used, deal +20% increased damage with heavy weapons for 1 hour.
- **Small Gun Bobblehead**
"Because it's easier to be brave from a safe distance."
 When used, deal +20% more damage with ballistic firearms for 1 hour.
- **Crown cap bobblehead**
"In the end you always have to have more than you had at the beginning."
 Your chance of finding better bottle cap supplies doubles when used for 1 hour.
- **Medicine bobblehead**
"The smart person knows that a bandage only hides the wounds."
 When used, Stimpaks restore +30% more health for 1 hour.
- **Melee Bobblehead**
"Business is best done in person and in direct contact."
 When used, deal +20% more damage with melee weapons for 1 hour.
- **Repair bobblehead**
"Why go down with the ship when you can repair it?"
 When used, Fusion Cores last 30% longer for 1 hour.
- **Creep Bobblehead**
"The safest route from point A to point B is in the shadows."
 You are 30% harder to detect for 1 hour when used.
- **Lock Picking Bobblehead**
"One should always strive for the unattainable."
 The optimal lock picking range is 30% larger when used for 1 hour.
- **Explosive bobblehead**
"The best way to solve problems is to get them out of the world."
 When used, deal +30% more damage with explosives for 1 hour.
- **Strength Bobblehead**
"It's important to reinforce your arguments."
 You gain +2 Strength for 1 hour when used.
- **bobblehead: charisma**
"A winning smile is the most beautiful language."
 You gain +2 Charisma for 1 hour when used.
- **bobblehead: intelligence**
"It takes the brightest minds to realize that there is always something new to learn."
 You gain +2 Intelligence for 1 hour when used.
- **Unarmed Bobblehead**
"When words are of no use, there are always fists."
 When used, deal +25% increased damage with unarmed attacks for 1 hour.
